description_en: Deletes one or more versions of a specified launch template by specifying parameters such as LaunchTemplateId and DeleteVersion
description_zh: 指定LaunchTemplateId、DeleteVersion等参数，删除指定实例启动模板的一个或多个版本
kebab_example: aliyun ecs delete-launch-template-version --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --delete-version 2 --launch-template-id lt-bp1apo0bbbkuy0rj0000 --launch-template-name testLaunchTemplateName --region cn-hangzhou
name: DeleteLaunchTemplateVersion
